name: Teriyaki Veggie Burger with Grilled Onions & Pineapple-Broccoli Slaw

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small pineapples
9 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a small saucepan.
Add broth, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce to the saucepan with the ginger and garlic; whisk to combine. Place over high heat and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Once the liquid in the saucepan comes to a boil, add slurry in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Let boil for 1 minute, then remove teriyaki sauce from heat and set aside.
Peel and slice onions crosswise into thin rings. Transfer to a large plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the onions and grill, flipping once, until tender and lightly charred, 3-4 minutes. Return onions to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for the burger patties.)

Meanwhile, place veggie ground, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, and half of the teriyaki sauce in a large bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the veggie ground mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on another plate. (Reserve remaining teriyaki sauce for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g veggie ground, plant based
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are done, return the pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Add to the plate with the onions and re-cover with foil.
While the patties are cooking, place additional oil, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce in a clean large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice bok choy crosswise into shred-like strips; add to the bowl, along with the broccoli slaw, and toss to combine.

Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; layer with burger patties, remaining teriyaki sauce, onions, and a small portion of the slaw. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
